definitions.gloss: laundry room; utility room for laundry
definitions.explanation: A dedicated room or space in a home, apartment building, or facility equipped for washing, drying, and sometimes ironing clothes.

examples.japanese: ランドリールーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{洗濯|せんたく}する→洗濯する：09656_sentakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I do laundry in the laundry room.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一階|いっかい}→一階：27512_ikkai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ランドリールーム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a shared laundry room on the first floor of the apartment building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新築|しんちく}→新築：06567_shinchiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ランドリールーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧、⟦{室内干|しつないぼ}し→室内干し：19247_shitsunaiboshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦スペース→スペース：11049_supeesu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In the new house, I want to build a laundry room with enough space for indoor drying.

notes:
A loanword from English 'laundry room.' In Japanese homes, a dedicated laundry room has become increasingly popular in modern house design, especially as a solution for indoor drying (⟦{室内干|しつないぼ}し→室内干し：19247_shitsunaiboshi⟧) during rainy seasons. Traditional Japanese homes typically have the washing machine in the bathroom area (⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧).

In apartment buildings and hotels, the term often refers to a shared coin-operated laundry facility, similar to a laundromat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧ランドリールーム: shared laundry room
- ランドリールーム⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧: with a laundry room
- ランドリールーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to install/set up a laundry room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦コインランドリー→コインランドリー：09732_koinrandorii⟧: coin laundry; laundromat — a commercial self-service laundry
- ⟦{脱衣所|だついじょ}→脱衣所：17619_datsuijo⟧: changing room/utility area — the traditional space where washing machines are placed in Japanese homes
- {洗濯室|せんたくしつ}: laundry room — the Japanese-origin equivalent, used in institutional settings
